decks.notes: This deck aims to quickly assemble the combo of Nomads en-Kor, Springheart Nantuko, and Nadu, Winged Wisdom to generate infinite card draw and mana, leading to a win through either decking the opponent with Thassa's Oracle or generating enough mana to overwhelm them. It utilizes efficient mana creatures like Noble Hierarch and Birds of Paradise, as well as powerful green spells like Green Sun's Zenith and Chord of Calling, to set up the combo quickly and protect it with cards like Allosaurus Shepherd and Sylvan Safekeeper.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly disrupt and control the opponent while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. The deck focuses on using efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Force of Will to clear the way for creatures like Murktide Regent and Troll of Khazad-dûm. Additionally, cards like Thoughtseize and Daze help disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Reanimate and Brazen Borrower provide flexibility and additional threats. The deck aims to tempo out the opponent by controlling the game's pace and winning through consistent damage.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and hand disruption, while also maintaining a fast and aggressive tempo with efficient removal spells and creatures. The key strategy is to control the board early on and apply pressure with small evasive threats like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent. The deck also utilizes card advantage engines like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Snapcaster Mage to keep the pressure on the opponent and maintain a consistent game plan. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure smooth gameplay and access to all necessary colors of mana.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and disruption spells to control the pace of the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By using cards like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Daze to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also deploying threats like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf to pressure the opponent, this deck aims to maintain tempo and momentum throughout the game. Additionally, cards like Fatal Push and Brazen Borrower provide versatile answers to opposing threats. Overall, this deck is designed to be proactive and aggressive, while also being disruptive and controlling when necessary.

The deck is focused on quickly milling through your library to put Thassa's Oracle on top and win the game with its ability. It utilizes a combination of fast mana, discard spells, and graveyard recursion to quickly assemble the combo and go off before the opponent has a chance to react. The deck aims to win in a single explosive turn, sacrificing a lot of its own resources in order to achieve victory. The key strategy is to carefully manage resources and timing to set up the combo while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Lotus Petal and Eldrazi Temple, allowing you to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Thought-Knot Seer and It That Heralds the End. Chalice of the Void is used to disrupt your opponent's game plan, while cards like Wasteland and Glaring Fleshraker help control the board. The inclusion of cards like The One Ring and Gaea's Cradle provide additional benefits and versatility to the deck's strategy, making it a potent Aggro deck in the Legacy format.

The deck revolves around cheating big, powerful creatures into play quickly using Show and Tell and Omniscience. Atraxa, Grand Unifier serves to further support this strategy. The deck also includes cards like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand for maximum impact. The deck runs various mana acceleration cards like Lotus Petal and Elvish Spirit Guide to help get the big threats out as early as possible. The combination of Show and Tell with powerful creatures like Emrakul can often lead to overwhelming board states and quick victories.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize. Then, use spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring these creatures back onto the battlefield for an explosive combo finish. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Daze to control the game and protect the combo. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful reanimated creatures while controlling the game through disruption spells.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while maintaining a fast and aggressive tempo. It combines efficient removal spells like Fatal Push with powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Orcish Bowmasters. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Daze and Thoughtseize to keep the opponent off balance. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and helps dig for key pieces. The goal is to apply pressure while disrupting the opponent's strategy, ultimately overwhelming them with threats and disruption.

The deck revolves around assembling the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill out your opponent's deck. It utilizes fast mana like Simian Spirit Guide and Ancient Tomb to power out its combo pieces quickly. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void and Karn, the Great Creator to protect the combo. With a mix of control elements like Ensnaring Bridge and powerful removal in Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition.

The deck is focused on controlling the game by utilizing counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to maintain board control and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of cards like Counterbalance and Scroll Rack allows for additional ways to control the opponents' spells, while cards like Entreat the Angels and Terminus provide win conditions. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the control elements of the deck, with a mix of dual lands and fetch lands to ensure consistent access to the required colors. Overall, the deck aims to outlast opponents and win through attrition.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly generate a large amount of mana using cards like Lion's Eye Diamond, Lotus Petal, and rituals like Dark Ritual and Cabal Ritual. This mana is then used to cast powerful spells like Ad Nauseam and Infernal Tutor to find the combo pieces needed to win the game. The deck also includes disruption in the form of discard spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to help protect the combo. The win condition is usually Tendrils of Agony, which is cast multiple times in a single turn to deal lethal damage to the opponent.

The deck revolves around assembling the Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor combo to mill the entire library, use Dread Return to bring back Thassa's Oracle, and win the game with Oracle's ETB ability. The deck includes control elements like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to protect the combo, alongside card selection and manipulation tools such as Brainstorm and Ponder. Urza's Saga and Nadu, Winged Wisdom provide additional combo pieces and support for the strategy. The deck aims to quickly and efficiently execute its combo to secure victory.

This Legacy 1 vs 1 combo deck aims to quickly cheat powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Emrakul, the Aeons Torn onto the battlefield by using Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. The deck also includes ways to protect the combo with cards like Force of Will and Flusterstorm. By utilizing efficient card draw with Ponder and Brainstorm, as well as ramping with Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide, the deck is designed to overwhelm opponents with massive creatures and secure a swift victory.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with aggressive creatures, spells, and disruption. The deck utilizes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Daze, along with disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to slow down the opponent. Meanwhile, aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent, combined with tempo plays like Brainstorm and Ponder, aim to close out the game quickly. The mana base is built around fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors of mana.

The main focus of the deck is to utilize cards like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead to quickly and efficiently bring powerful creatures from the graveyard back into play. The deck also features disruption elements like Force of Will, Daze, and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and disrupt opponents. The inclusion of cards like Psychic Frog and Archon of Cruelty provide additional value and control options. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.
